name: Tengen Uzui
classification: Human; Demon Slayer; Shinobi; Sound Hashira
summary: Tengen Uzui is the Sound Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps and a former shinobi. Raised in a brutal shinobi clan, Tengen developed extraordinary physical abilities, senses, combat skills, and resistance to poison. He created Sound Breathing, which combines his enhanced hearing, shinobi expertise, dual Nichirin cleavers, bombs, and his Musical Score technique.

stats.liftingStrength: At least Class 25, likely Class K
stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Explosives and Breathing Styles

notes: Tengen's Sound Breathing combines his heightened hearing, shinobi techniques, dual Nichirin cleavers, bombs, and Musical Score. His Musical Score allows him to analyze an opponent's movements as sound and identify openings. He continued fighting after losing an arm and an eye while severely poisoned by Gyutaro. The VS Battles profile rates him at Town level with Massively Hypersonic+ speed.
